wikitext: {{EpicodePrevNext| prevcode=None | prevtitle=None | nextcode=PG02 | nexttitle=The Chase | series=Pokémon Generations | colorscheme=Hoso}} {{EpisodeInfobox| epcode=PG01 | colorscheme=Hoso| title_en=The Adventure | title_ja=冒険 | title_ja_trans=The Adventure | release_method=Web release | screen=hd | broadcast_jp=December 9, 2016| broadcast_us=September 16, 2016| en_op=N/A | ja_op=N/A | ja_ed=N/A | olmteam=Team Kato | scenario=冨岡淳広 | storyboard=冨安大貴 | director=吉野真一 | art=吉野真一 | morecredits=no | epstaffpage=PG01-PG10 | footnotes=* ''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FHxZpk_hvJA The Adventure]'' on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel. * ''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KRkvy-8woX8 The Adventure]'' in HD on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel. * {{BMGf|218432|Review thread on BMGf}} }} '''The Adventure''' (Japanese: '''冒険''' ''The Adventure'') is the first episode of [[Pokémon Generations]]. It was first released on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on September 16, 2016. It was uploaded to the official Japanese Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on December 9, 2016. It was reuploaded on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel in HD on December 14, 2016. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== From Viridian Forest to Terminus Cave, see the Pokémon world as never before! ==Plot== The episode begins with the [[Game intro|intro screen]] of {{game|Red and Blue|s|Pokémon Red Version}}, with the {{player}} resuming a saved game. The player character, simply named "{{pkmn|Trainer}}", is walking through [[Viridian Forest]] in the [[Kanto]] [[region]], where he quickly encounters a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{TP|Red|Pikachu}}. One {{i|Poké Ball}} throw later, the Pikachu is {{pkmn2|caught}}. The scene transits from the game environment into proper {{pkmn|animation}}, with the Trainer, {{ga|Red}}, picking up the Poké Ball containing the newly caught Pikachu. He sends it out again, and it begins to explore its surroundings. It quickly encounters a {{p|Caterpie}}, which attacks with {{m|String Shot}}, but Pikachu successfully dodges the strings before counterattacking, just as {{p|Zapdos}} flies past the screen. The scenery changes, now depicting Pikachu climbing up a tree in [[Ecruteak City]] in the [[Johto]] region. It fires a {{m|Thunder Shock}} at a group of {{p|Wooper}} in the river below, but the {{t|Ground}} types are unaffected by the attack, and strike back with {{m|Mud Shot}} just as {{p|Lugia}} flies by, sending Pikachu flying. Now Pikachu is battling a {{p|Vigoroth}} outside of the [[Weather Institute]] on {{rt|119|Hoenn}} in the [[Hoenn]] region. The two battling Pokémon make their way across the nearby wooden bridge while being observed by {{p|Latios}} and {{p|Latias}}. Suddenly, the battle causes the bridge to start collapsing, forcing both Pokémon to rush to the other side to avoid falling down. Outside of the [[Snowpoint Temple]] in the [[Sinnoh]] region, Pikachu is battling a {{p|Probopass}}, whose Mini-Noses keep attacking it with beams of energy. The commotion, however, causes {{p|Regigigas}} to wake up and emerge from the temple. After easily smacking Probopass aside and shrugging off Pikachu's {{t|Electric}} attack, the [[Legendary Pokémon]] unleashes a devastating attack around itself. In the [[Desert Resort]] in the [[Unova]] region, Pikachu and Red enter the [[Relic Castle]]. Pikachu accidentally falls into a sand pit, causing it to fall into a deeper part of the castle, where it comes face to face with {{p|Volcarona}}. The {{t|Bug}}/{{t|Fire}} Pokémon attacks Pikachu with {{m|Heat Wave}}, but Pikachu uses {{m|Iron Tail}} on a floor tile, using it to block the attack. Pikachu counterattacks with {{m|Volt Tackle}}, defeating Volcarona. Just then, {{p|Landorus}} emerges from underneath the floor and prepares to attack Pikachu. Now in [[Terminus Cave]] in the [[Kalos]] region, both Red and Pikachu are riding a mine cart while being attacked by a wild {{p|Noivern}}. Noivern attacks the two with a narrowly missing {{m|Dragon Pulse}}, while Pikachu strikes Noivern with {{m|Electro Ball}}. The attack momentarily grounds Noivern, but it quickly recovers, now attacking with {{m|Boomburst}}. Before the attack can hit, however, Pikachu counters with a {{m|Thunderbolt}}, defeating Noivern. At the end of the mine cart ride, Red and Pikachu encounter {{p|Zygarde}} in its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Complete Forme}}. A bright pillar of light forms around the Legendary Pokémon, forcing Red to momentarily cover his eyes as Zygarde begins to ascend into the sky through a hole in the cave ceiling. The camera pulls out to show the entire {{pkmn|world|planet}} as the title "Pokémon Generations" appears on the screen. ==Major events== * {{ga|Red}} {{pkmn2|caught|catches}} a {{TP|Red|Pikachu}}. * Red travels through [[Kanto]], [[Johto]], [[Hoenn]], [[Sinnoh]], [[Unova]], and [[Kalos]]. ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{ga|Red}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Bulbasaur}} ({{ga|Red}}'s) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Red's Pikachu|Red's]];
